# Thermocouple change sequence

An assigned equipment technician isolates the chamber using the workshop's fictional isolation board and marks the work ticket SENSOR EXCHANGE. This is synthetic procedure text, not real electrical guidance.

Record the removed and installed serials, reproduce the labelled insertion mark, and record the fictional fixture socket code before closing the cover. Use the matching labelled assembly; an unlabelled assembly stays in the tray.

Finish the hardware entry with the technician role and work-ticket identifier. Leave the chamber marked awaiting a check. Follow [post-change calibration](calibration.md#post-change-check) before production resumes. A successful hardware swap alone does not release production.
